purpose: New matched-input offline annotation prediction, not original score reproduction
alignment: Images t-1,t; target actions.txt[t+1]. No future image is shown. Original collector environment-step alignment is not documented; this is next-annotation prediction, not a proven control policy.
hold_definition: actions[t+1] == actions[t]; current action is stated only in hold question
qwen_method: Conditional next-token probability over one-token answer labels; no thinking or generation. Separate question prompts; fixed option order.
omnijev_method: MSO1 typed heads, packed questions; temperature=1, noul bias=0; argmax includes abstention.
limitations: Original 735-question identities/prompts/splits unavailable in inspected release
Samples may overlap OmniJev training; this is not a new held-out benchmark
Frames within a clip are correlated; no episode-level generalization claim
Qwen label likelihoods differ from unpublished original A1_raw implementation
No closed-loop game run or completion-rate measurement
